independence.rationale: S1 and S2 complete the schema and API layer. S3 adds the distinct user-facing behavior of displaying batch and serial as separate UI fields. S1 and S2 together do not render the UI change; S3's presentation layer is independently observable by the end user.

iWantTo: see batch_number and serial_number as separate fields in the stock list and forms
soThat: I can view and manage batch and serial information independently
